# Börsen mot öppning i sidled – Sandvik håller kapitalmarknadsdag

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon on 2026-11-24 covered a cautious Stockholm open after a big rally driven by AI. The rally followed Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO, though the panel said AI worries and volatility remain. Guest Georg Attlund said last week's sharp sell-off has historically been a good entry point and supported buying the dip. He added that upward estimate revisions are narrow and mostly in AI names. Company coverage included Sandvik's capital markets day (tungsten, possible over-capitalisation), Vimian's reaffirmed 2030 targets, Tomra's lowered targets, Yubico's turnaround story, Hemnet's strategy shift and estimate risk, Scandi Standard's main owner selling shares, and ABG rating changes on Clas Ohlson and Boliden.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

ABG resumed coverage with a sell rating; shares fell 2-6%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view (ABG), not the hosts' own. ABG resumed coverage with a sell rating and the market reacted at once, with the stock widening its losses to about 5-6% during the morning. The hosts did not add any thesis of their own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if ABG upgrades
- if the next report beats expectations

> *"Clas Ohlson har fått en återupptagen bevakning från ABG men med ett säljråd. Aktien ner drygt 2 procent."*

---

### 🟢 BOL — Boliden | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

ABG upgraded to buy from hold, but shares fell with the mining sector.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view: ABG upgraded Boliden to buy from hold. The stock still fell 1.4-2% on sector-wide mining headwinds after the previous day's rally. The hosts gave no view of their own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if metal prices weaken
- if mining sector headwinds persist

> *"Boliden ner 1,4 procent. Där har ABG höjt Boliden till köp från tidigare behåll."*

---

### 🟢 YUBICO — Yubico | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Large Q3 orders, easy comps and about 30% growth expected in Q4 and Q1. The guest says management is doing the right things.

#### Reasoning

Guest Georg Attlund sees about 30% growth in Q4 and Q1, helped by easy US public-sector comps after the shutdown and big Q3 orders delivered in Q4. He backs the YubiID subscription launch, the shift of keys to subscription and the new technically minded CEO. The stock works as long as the cybersecurity narrative holds, but it has already doubled and he says underlying fundamentals have changed less than headline growth suggests.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the cybersecurity narrative fades
- if large orders dry up
- if US public-sector demand weakens again

> *"Och så länge det här underliggande narrativet om cybersäkerhetens vikt består så kommer den aktien att funka."*

---

### 🟡 HEM — Hemnet | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The guest's firm cut it to neutral after Q3 on high 2027 estimate risk. It looks cheap, but paid versus free listing volumes are unclear.

#### Reasoning

Guest analyst view: downgraded to neutral after Q3 because next year's estimates depend on how many listings stay paid versus free. A host flagged governance risk from an interim CEO and an influential owner (Sprint). Both say the strategy shift was necessary and the stock looks cheap. Traffic is the key to customers' willingness to pay.

#### Sell Triggers

- if paid listing share collapses
- if traffic declines
- if governance turmoil escalates

> *"vi tog ner den här aktien efter Q3-rapporten till neutral just på den höga estimatrisken i nästa år."*

---

### 🟠 SCST — Scandi Standard | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

The largest owner, Lusiaves, has sold twice, a worrying change of direction that makes a bid less likely.

#### Reasoning

Host Martin Blomgren: the Portuguese structural buyer is now selling, possibly to lock in a large gain. That lowers the chance of a takeover bid, and Öresund and Qviberg have said any buyout would be very expensive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Lusiaves continues selling

> *"när den köparen nu byter riktning, även om det, precis som du säger, är en liten mängd, men oroande riktningsändring."*

---

### 🟠 TOM — Tomra | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host praised the honesty and low valuation and sees new deposit-return systems as a tailwind. The market fell about 5%.

#### Reasoning

The host cheered Tomra's self-critical reset and its now-low valuation. New deposit-return systems (the UK, regulation-driven) could help it. But margins are about 11-12% against a 16-18% target, France disappointed, and the stock fell about 5%. The host conceded it takes time to turn the business around.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new deposit-return systems are delayed further
- if margins keep missing targets

> *"Jag tycker det är uppfriskande, självkritiskt och ärligt. Jag säger heja Tomra."*

---

### 🟠 SAND — Sandvik | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Capital markets day: possible margin-target raise, an over-capitalised balance sheet (dividend, buyback or M&A) and tungsten supply advantages.

#### Reasoning

The stock has run strongly since the last capital markets day. Sandvik's own tungsten mine and recycling give it a supply edge over competitors. The balance sheet is nearing over-capitalisation, so higher dividends, buybacks or M&A are possible. The reporter doubts a target raise, while an analyst hopes for +1pp. Shares are down with the mining sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- if tungsten prices fall sharply
- if no capital allocation news

> *"Det börjar närma sig att man skulle kalla Sandvik överkapitaliserat."*

---

### 🟠 VIMIAN — Vimian | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Reaffirmed the EUR 300m adj. EBITA 2030 target (nearly 3x), backed by a resilient animal-health market and acquisitions.

#### Reasoning

This is company management's view (CEO Ali Tajbakhsh), not an independent host call. Targets assume 10% organic growth, 10-15% acquired growth and EUR 25m from AI and efficiency. The animal-health market is described as resilient through economic cycles.

#### Sell Triggers

- if acquisition pace slows
- if organic growth falls below 10%

> *"vi återupprepar vårt mål 2030 med justerade bitar på 300 miljoner euro"*
